mdcompose.executablePath.markdownDescription: Full path to the `mdcompose` executable. Leave empty to use the one on the executable search path. This can be set only in user or machine settings, never by a workspace.

mdcompose.timeoutSeconds.markdownDescription: How long a single `mdcompose` command may run before it is stopped.
